tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Return the full text of one kevurugames.com page as markdown, by the id from search results (its canonical URL).

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Return the full markdown of one kevurugames.com page by its canonical URL (e.g. https://kevurugames.com/our-latest-projects/). The same as fetch, as plain text.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.kevurugames.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_page · Private data: submit_inquiry · Public sink: submit_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_page · Private data: submit_inquiry · Public sink: submit_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
